decisions.reason: Building on the firm's established training and service offer, the firm can interpret and improve it through its related knowledge and R&D.
As an accessory building on existing rotary axis and precision tool know-how, it is within the firm's absorptive capacity and likely kept.
Distant from established mechanical machining and dispensing competencies, the firm cannot easily interpret or learn from early results, despite its R&D.
Close to the firm's core high-speed machining machines and process know-how, so related knowledge supports assimilation and improvement.
Building on established machine accessories and automation, the firm has the related knowledge to evaluate and refine it.
